findings.description: Exact known external DoH hosts could reach Android/iOS domestic DIRECT

findings.description: Loopback core tests over-trusted asynchronous reject log lines and one-shot idempotent controller requests
findings.resolution: Judge REJECT by zero outbound relay connections and datagrams; retry only transient local API resets for idempotent GET, PUT and DELETE, without suppressing failed core results
